customers_say: Customers find the water purifier reliable, budget-friendly, and easy to use, with good water quality that tests clean and pure. They appreciate the free installation process, and the water has a good taste. The service and customer experience receive mixed feedback - while some report prompt service, others find the customer care team disappointing.

reviews.author: Rajesh Jayam
reviews.title: Aquaguard Purifier
reviews.body: The water purifier works well and provides clean, safe-tasting water. The quality is good, and it is easy to use. Overall, I’m satisfied with the product.

reviews.author: Rajkumar Yaduwanshi
reviews.title: Good Product and Satisfactory Performance
reviews.body: The RO water purifier is working well and provides clean, good-tasting water. The design is nice, and it is easy to use. Overall, I am satisfied with the product and would recommend it to others.

reviews.author: sangram keshari dash
reviews.title: Very dissatisfied
reviews.body: I purchased this Aquaguard water purifier from Amazon expecting clean and pure drinking water. However, after installation, the technician informed me that I needed to install an additional iron filter, which would cost ₹2,100 extra. If I am purchasing a water purifier, I expect to know about such additional requirements and costs beforehand, not after the product has been delivered and installed. Why should I have to pay extra just to make the purifier suitable for my water? This experience has been extremely disappointing. reviews.title: Good product and Quick Installation from Acqugard technician
reviews.body: Good product and Technician has good knowledge and explained all details. Delivery and installation done on same day

reviews.author: Mukul sinha
reviews.title: A good buy with average build quality
reviews.body: It’s working fine after installing a TDS controller, as the company doesn’t provide one. Although my tap water has a TDS of around 120 ppm, I purchased an RO purifier due to the presence of heavy metals. The RO reduced the TDS to 10–15 ppm, so a TDS controller was needed. However, since it bypasses some untreated water, the RO’s purpose is somewhat compromised, as some heavy metals may remain in the final water. Whole body is of plastic having build quality not as expected.Apperance is good, installation service was fast but after sale service is slow.Overall,a good buy,but let's see how it go
